images.filename: Bolnes - Zeemeermin op de golven (1993) van Jaap Hartman.jpg
images.caption: Monument in remembrance of the completion of the "Delta Works" at the IJsselmonde. Made by Jaap Hartman in 1993. Placed at the Benedenrijweg / Ringdijk in Bolnes (Ridderkerk)
images.alt: Monument in remembrance of the completion of the "Delta Works" at the IJsselmonde. Made by Jaap Hartman in 1993. Placed at the Benedenrijweg / Ringdijk in Bolnes (Ridderkerk)

images.caption:
After floodings of 1953 in the Netherlands the Deltaworks were executed to protect the coast.
Part of the work was the closure of a sea arm called Het Volkerak.

Open caissons where placed in the opening and closed when the tidal current was dead and then the caissons were quickly filled with sand and covered up.
